g.text: Affordability v28.0/28.1 — trigger → verdict → manners → sentence → toast
The debounce matters: a half-built plan
(three blocks placed, two to go) is exactly
or 30 s of quiet after AppData::changed()
for each open task with a deadline
WHAT IS TRUE — afford:: (pure, tested headless)
never toasts: "I don't know" as an
"…I can't tell how much is left"
store NOTHING — the heads-up was never
delivered, so it is still owed. The next
sweep outside the suppression says it
SENTENCE — 28.1: the model phrases, the C++ voice guarantees
No route walk: the fallback seat IS
argument again. A nudge cannot fail —
only sound more or less human.
deliver() — the ONE exit: cap bump +
verdict store happen at DELIVERY, so
the two voices cannot diverge on
seam, for when tapping a toast has
